main.description: One spent unit token on the public bulletin board: the anonymized ballot. Published by the BOARD CUSTODIAN (the org DID, per the custody decision in docs/ballot-board-custody.md), never by the voter: an atproto record lives in a DID-owned repo, so voter publication would deanonymize the ballot by repo ownership. This record deliberately has NO voter identity field, and every entry weighs exactly 1 (unit tokens), so the tally is a plain count of entries per choice. Token uniqueness on the board is the double-vote rejection; on a reused token the FIRST entry stands. Crypto field encodings are PROVISIONAL pending the ballot-spec crate's pinned serialization.

pollRef.description: The poll this ballot belongs to. The strongRef's CID pins the exact poll version (question, options, rules, issuerPubkey) the entry was validated against.

token.description: PROVISIONAL encoding: the unblinded unit token's message, a 32-byte voter-generated random nullifier, as base64url (unpadded). Carries no structure and no identity; its uniqueness on the board is the dedup.

msgRandomizer.description: PROVISIONAL encoding: the RFC 9474 message randomizer from blinding (the RSABSSA Randomized variant), base64url (unpadded). Optional per the spec crate's shape; required by verification when present at signing.

signature.description: PROVISIONAL encoding: the unblinded RSA-PSS signature over token, base64url (unpadded). Verifies under the referenced poll's published issuerPubkey; per-poll keys make cross-poll spends unverifiable.

choices.description: Selected option indices into the poll's options array, subject to the poll's minVote, maxVote, and blank rules.
